slide3.body: We build Lightship ISM for fleet managers. SeaTime Tracker puts the same standards into the hands of individual officers and engineers.

tax.title: Tax days
tax.disclaimer: Guidance only. Check with a tax adviser. Day counts are only one part of tax residence, and tax treaties can change the answer.
tax.none: No countries picked. Tap Choose countries.
tax.noRule: No day rule in the app for this country, so this is a plain count by calendar year.
tax.countMidnight: Counts the days you are there at midnight. The day you leave does not count.
tax.countAnyPart: Any part of a day counts, so arrival and departure days both count.
tax.unrecorded_one: {{count}} day in this year has no stay logged.
tax.unrecorded_other: {{count}} days in this year have no stay logged.

detail.ieTwoYear: This year and last: {{total}} of 280 days.
detail.zaPpt: The 5 years before: {{total}} days. You need more than 915, and more than 91 in each year.
detail.nzRolling_one: Most in any 12 months: {{count}} day. More than 183 makes you resident.
detail.nzRolling_other: Most in any 12 months: {{count}} days. More than 183 makes you resident.

notes.GB: Statutory Residence Test: 183 days or more in the UK in a tax year makes you UK resident. Fewer days can also make you resident if you have UK ties.
notes.US: Substantial presence test: 31 days this year and 183 days over 3 years (all of this year, a third of last year, a sixth of the year before). Days as crew of a foreign vessel do not count: turn those stays off for tax.
notes.AU: 183-day test: in Australia for more than half the income year. You can still be non-resident if your usual home is overseas.
notes.NZ: More than 183 days in New Zealand in any 12-month period makes you tax resident from the first of those days.
notes.ZA: Physical presence test: more than 91 days this tax year and in each of the 5 years before, and more than 915 days over those 5 years.
notes.IE: 183 days in a tax year, or 280 days over this year and last. A year with 30 days or fewer does not count towards the 280.
notes.CA: Staying 183 days or more in a calendar year can make you a deemed resident if you have no significant ties to Canada.
notes.ES: More than 183 days in Spain in a calendar year. Short trips away can still count as days in Spain.
notes.FR: More than six months in France in a year usually makes it your main place of stay. Your home, job or main income in France can also make you resident.
notes.IT: In Italy for most of the year (183 days, or 184 in a leap year). From 2024 physical presence alone can count.
notes.DE: An unbroken stay of more than six months, even across the year end. Short breaks do not stop the stay, but this app only joins days with no gap.

tax.pickIntro: Pick the countries you want day counts for. Countries in this list have their own tax year and day rule.
tax.otherCountriesHelp: Any other country gets a plain day count by calendar year.

sed.title: UK Seafarers' Earnings Deduction
sed.intro: Checks the day tests only: 365 days or more, mostly outside the UK, with no UK visit over 183 days. A day abroad is a day you are outside the UK at midnight. Days with no stay logged count as UK days.
sed.current: Current period: {{start}} to {{end}}, {{days}} days ({{away}} away, {{uk}} in the UK).
sed.broken: More than 183 days in the UK since this period ended, so a new period starts with your next trip.
sed.disclaimer: Guidance only. Check with a tax adviser. SED has other conditions too, such as the type of ship and where the work is done.
